How to choose your seat in advance

During booking

You can select your seat while booking your flight on swiss.com.

After booking

You can reserve your seat for a fee via your personal profile up to 2 hours before departure.

Reserve seat now

At online check-in

You can also select a seat during online check-in.

You will be allocated a seat automatically during online check-in if you did not choose your seat in advance. You can change it for a fee depending on the fare and seat category selected. This fee is not payable by passengers who have booked a seat in advance, providing the newly selected seat is of the same or a lower seat category.

More information

You have the right to a free advance seat reservation according to the regulations of the Italian Civil Aviation Authority (ENAC) on flights from and to Italy if you meet the following criteria: you are travelling with a child between the ages of 2 and 12 years and/or you are a passenger with a disability or are travelling with a passenger with a disability. The Lufthansa Group will ensure you get a complimentary seat next to one another at check-in.

Advance seat reservations on Edelweiss flights

You will find all the details and the latest prices directly on the Edelweiss website if you need to reserve a seat on an Edelweiss flight, or you would like more information about the various seat options.
